messages:
sophia: Heads-up — onboarding a new APAC edge account (aws acct 987654321000) for customer 'NovaSense'. They need GPU capacity in ap-southeast-4 and some network headroom. Can infra raise quotas?

max: +1. What families and counts?

sophia: Asking for initial slice: p5.24xlarge x4, p4d.24xlarge x2, g5.48xlarge x6. Also ENI increase to support 200 ENIs and EFA quota for the p5/p4 families.

kevin: p5 availability in that region is uncertain. Recommend we request fallback model counts (g5) for soft capacity: prefer p5x4 but if not available allow g5x8. Also ask for 10 placement groups and request resource-based quotas for placement groups if AWS enforces.

sanjay: I'll open the Service Quotas/SDA ticket. Typical requests: "EC2 P5 instances", "EC2 P4d instances", "G5 instances", "Network interfaces per ENI", "EFA interfaces per region".

sophia: Please include our expected sustained commit pattern — rolling tests for 2 weeks starting next month. We need guaranteed soft limits so Dedicated onboarding won't fail. Also add note about burst reservations for first 48 hours.

kevin: Also ask for elastic ip limit bump? onboarding scripts attach EIPs for NAT in our VPCs. Currently default is 5. Request 50.

sanjay: Creating support case now. I'll post case numbers when created. CLI snippet I'll use (so you can approve):

```bash
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A \  
  --desired-value 12 --region ap-southeast-4

# p5/p4/g5 are SKU-specific; sometimes need to request by instance-type quota via support central
```

quota-bot: Automated message: "New AWS Service Quota request created: case CAS-2026-0001234. Track progress at https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/cases#CAS-2026-0001234" :white_check_mark:

max: Nice. Can we cap monthly spend per account while we validate? Add note to the support case: we will enforce a hard budget of $50k for the first 30 days.

sanjay: Added budget note to the case and linked cost center RC-Infra-Onboard.

sophia: Also: networking nit — our kubelet ENI assignment needs per-instance ENI quota of at least 8 for g5. Request instance-level ENI quota bump where possible.

kevin: Reminder to request EC2 placement group concurrent limit bump. Some regions cap PGs to 2 per account by default. We need 10.

sanjay: Case updated: CAS-2026-0001234 — requested p5:4, p4d:2, g5:6; fallback g5:8, ENIs per region:200, EFA quota:10, EIP limit:50, placement-groups:10. ETA from AWS usually 24-72h but p5 capacity requests can take longer.

sophia: Thanks. If AWS pushes back on p5 due to capacity, we will accept temporary mapping to g5 and a rollout window extension. Please ensure node boot scripts have instance-type fallback logic.

kevin: Adding snippet for fallback logic (kube autoscaler tag):

```yaml
# deployment hint: instanceTypes prioritized list
nodeGroup:
  instanceTypes: ["p5.24xlarge","g5.48xlarge","p4d.24xlarge"]
  maxSize: 16
```

quota-bot: AWS replied: "We are processing CAS-2026-0001234. p5 capacity not currently available in ap-southeast-4; recommending g5 family as alternative. Please confirm acceptance."

sophia: Confirmed we accept g5 fallback for initial onboarding. Keep p5 on the roadmap and reopen if capacity improves.

sanjay: Marking this thread resolved for action items. Will paste the final case outcome here once closed.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: onboarding-runner to start 2026-06-01 03:00 UTC (depends on quota confirmation).

max: Thanks team — please ping #product-onboard when quotas are confirmed so they can schedule integration tests. :thumbsup:
